_note: v2.5 plan 01 live gates G1 (a/b), G2, G5 and G8 over the lane's REAL library books (overview rule 10: LANES ONLY, never the user's live install). Run twice back to back on one lane with a run header around the batch: node scripts/debug/so-run-header.mts capture --label v25-01-g1; node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes 1 --repeat 2 test/scenarios/live-v25-01-real-books.json --group <a group holding Arin>; node scripts/debug/so-run-header.mts diff .debug/run-header-v25-01-g1.json. Precondition: a fresh lane (gatingMode file, empty ledger; the fixture refuses otherwise) whose library holds the real stories. It saves every gated real book to sessionStorage first, switches every present gated entry ON on disk (the S1 adversarial start), then switches to per-chat gating through the product's confirm (the popup's OK, as an author does). G2 (first run flips exactly the present gated set, non-gated entries byte-identical, ledger == present gated; second run 0 /api/worldinfo/edit), G1 (b) the other story's chat and (a) a no-story chat, scan view plus three real generations through the T12 ring, missingKey asserted 0, G8 (p95 <= 5 ms over 40 + 10 dry scans, real library plus a 500-entry bulk book, 250 of it gated by a marker story; its normalisation is the growth path, no second confirm), G5 (hand-enable one normalised entry through the API, reload: the start-up verify raises the Repair row, the file shows it on; re-normalise clears it). Cleanup removes the marker stories, returns to file mode, writes every saved book back and asserts each reads back identical, resets the ledger, and deletes SO-V25 books. G1 (c) and G5's 'extension disabled' half are manual: see _design. Predeclared conditions: docs/plans/v2.5/01-wi-scan-gating.md G1, G2, G5, G8; never retuned. Wait for 02 C2's attribution of the save race before the sign-off series (overview sequence).

_design.G1c: After this fixture's G2 phase (or its first run, before cleanup, using --keep): disable Story Orchestrator in ST's Extensions panel, reload, open the no-story Arin chat and run node scripts/debug/st-eval.mts "(await import('/scripts/world-info.js')).getSortedEntries().then((e) => e.filter((x) => x.disable !== true).map((x) => x.world + ': ' + x.comment))". PASS = no entry the ledger (localStorage so-v25-01 G2first) holds is in that list. Then re-enable the extension and run the cleanup step's eval by hand.
_design.G5-disabled: With the drifted entry of G5 left drifted (run up to the start-up check with --keep), disable the extension and reload: the drifted entry must be the ONLY ledger entry in the list above. Re-enable, re-normalise from the settings row (#so-wi-renormalize), then clean up.

_v26: T7 2026-10-03, two fixes. (1) The G5 start-up row is author-only since v2.6 plan 15 CR-U (3c2f7790): viewerRepairStep (src/runtime/repair.ts) shows a player only steps with player copy, and wiGatingStep has player: null, so in player mode the drift was found (drift 1, file entry on) and no row could show. Steps 24-25 read the row in Author view (switched on for the reading, waiting up to 5 s for the render both ways) and switch it off again before assert-player-clean, so the row is asserted shown on drift and gone after re-normalise exactly as before. (2) The cleanup (back to file mode through the product, every saved book written back and read back identical, ledger reset, marker stories and SO-V25 books removed) moved from the last two steps into cleanup.steps, which so-scenario runs in its finally (fixtureCleanupSteps), re-injecting both helpers first because a failure after the G5 reload leaves them unloaded. A red run used to skip it and leave the lane in scan mode with a ledger, so the next run refused as 'lane not fresh'.
